background: Principality Building Society is the largest building society in Wales, a mutual funded by retail savings from its branch network and lending on residential mortgages, with a commercial and development lending arm.
synthesis: Fitch rates the society BBB+ and Moody's Baa1 on a positive outlook, after Moody's upgrade to Baa1 on 3 Jul 2023. Capital is mixed against UK building societies: CET1 of 18.7% is above the peer median, while leverage of 5.3% is below the peer median. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 168% in the bottom quarter against 214% and NSFR of 144% a shade under 145%. The trend since 31 Dec 2022 is striking: CET1 has fallen 7.8 points, leverage 1.2 points and LCR 78 points, while NSFR has risen 10 points, so the society has grown its book and used up a great deal of headroom. The figures run to 31 Dec 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
